description: This file defines the BuzzShareAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing 'buzz shares' (social media sharing posts) within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It provides methods for creating, updating, and deleting buzz shares, including handling request validation, access control, and data transformation. The class interacts with data models and services to facilitate CRUD operations related to social media shares and posts.

classes.name: BuzzShareAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing social media shares within OrangeHRM, including creating, updating, and deleting shares.

methods.description: Method to retrieve all buzz shares; currently not implemented.

methods.description: Method to define validation rules for retrieving all buzz shares; not implemented.

methods.description: Defines validation rules for the create operation, including required share ID and optional text.

methods.description: Defines validation rules for deleting a buzz share by ID.
